- M3/M5 (non-deactivating) vs deactivating: a long-time experiment should show whether reaction actually completes

A critical test: run with very high substrate and moderate catalyst for a long time. Deactivating mechanisms fail to reach full conversion; M3/M5 do. Also high [S] distinguishes M11 (S+cat→inactive, faster deactivation at high S) from M9 (independent of S).
